name: MoodRing
author: GreasyCratez
summary: MOOD MKII-style wet channel and always-listening micro-looper sharing one stepped sample-rate clock (2k to 64k). Wet: reverb, delay, slip, freeze. Looper: env, tape, stretch, overdub. Hidden options, 16 dip switches, ramping, tap tempo, MPC-tempo sync and two preset slots. Every control sits on the pedal's own MIDI CC values.
